verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS platform, so a documented public API is a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack documents no public API. The HRIS integration is a first-party connector, not a public API that users can drive, and an llms.txt file is not an API. Probes of all candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
